allowPermissionsDesc: Bwe kinaakozesebwa, okuyita kwonna okw’ebikozesebwa mu MCP kujja kukkirizibwa mu ngeri ey’otoma awatali kulaga mboozi za lukusa. Ensengeka eno ekola mu nsi yonna ku mboozi zonna, omuli n’emboozi empya.

runtimeSettings.title: Enteekateeka z'obudde bw'okudduka
runtimeSettings.description: Tegeka engeri Novera gy'eddukanya n'okuddamu okugezaako seeva za MCP.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Obudde obusinga obunene okulinda okuddamu kw’ekintu kya MCP nga tonnaggwaako.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Ekiva mu kikozesebwa ekisinga obuwanvu ekikuumibwa mu mboozi. Ekintu kyonna ekiyise ku kino kisaliddwako era ne kiteekebwako akabonero nti kisaliddwako, kale ekivaamu ekimu ekinene tekisobola kumalawo mbeera ya muze. Teeka ku 0 okukuuma ebivuddemu nga bijjuvu.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRouting: Enkola y’ebikozesebwa mu ngeri ey’amagezi MCP
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Bwe kikozesebwa, Novera elonda seeva za MCP ezikwatagana nga tennatikka bikozesebwa. Lemesa bulijjo okutikka olukalala lw'ebikozesebwa bya MCP mu bujjuvu.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Nga smart routing etandise, dduka omutendera gw’okuyisa n’eky’enjawulo (ekitera okuba ekitono) mu kifo ky’eky’okukubaganya ebirowoozo. Ggyako bulijjo okukozesa enkola ya chat ekola ku routing.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Londa provider ne model mu kifo kimu. Ebika ebitono byokka bye biwandiikiddwa kale routing esigala ya mangu ate nga ya buseere.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Tewali bika bitono. Yongera ku model entono oba sengeka ebisumuluzo bya API mu Models.
